title.zh: SmartLingo 首页页眉与内容对齐
title.en: Align SmartLingo learning-page header and content

purpose.zh: 修复 iPad 横屏等中等宽度下页眉留白与首页内容边距不一致的问题，使卡片、标题与页眉沿相同左右边线排列。
purpose.en: Fix mismatched header and content gutters at iPad landscape and other widths so the title and cards align with the shared header edges.

zh: 将首页及复用该容器的快捷版、旗舰版、语言详情与面板统一到相同最大宽度与响应式左右边距。
为 WebKit 运行时布局检查增加页眉内容框与学习页面内容框左右边线的测量及回归断言。
en: Use the same maximum width and responsive horizontal gutters for the header and learning-page content on Home, Flash, Max, language detail, and Dashboard.
Measure the header and learning content edges in the WebKit runtime layout gate and reject regressions.

zh: 首页、快捷版、旗舰版、语言详情、会员面板及 WebKit 布局验证。
en: Home, Flash, Max, language detail, member dashboard, and WebKit layout verification.

zh: 修正原本页眉 56px 内边距与内容 20px 边距分开计算的 CSS；仅改变展示布局，不改路由、账户或数据。
en: Replace separate 56px header padding and 20px content gutters with one responsive alignment rule; no route, account, or data changes.

zh: 共享站点规则与架构检查、TypeScript、零警告 lint、全量测试、构建与敏感数据扫描，以及中英双语五种屏幕尺寸的 WebKit 运行时布局检查；部署后真实浏览器再次量测。
en: Shared policy/architecture checks, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full tests, build and sensitive-data scan, plus Chinese/English WebKit layout checks at five viewport sizes and post-deploy real-browser measurements.

zh: 本次仅改布局；不提交真实付款，也不更改或声称实测麦克风、实时媒体功能。
en: Visual-only change; no real payment is submitted, and microphone or live-media behavior is not changed or claimed to have been retested.

zh: 沿用现有 SmartLingo 页眉和学习页容器，无跨站资源、账号或密钥变动。
en: Reuse the existing SmartLingo header and learning shell without cross-site resources, accounts, or secrets.

rollback.zh: 如需回退，仅回退此布局提交；本次没有数据库迁移。
rollback.en: Revert this layout commit if needed; there is no database migration.
